integrity: The claim is a theorem about incidence nets; finite scripts test Desarguesian instances and are not substituted for the universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Rank-four ordinary first-order equivalence only; no counting quantifiers, higher ranks, or independent audit; non-Desarguesian universality is proved by axioms, not enumerated.
title: Forgetting the sides of biaffine nets collapses a rank-four distinction
